title: Iran rejects Trump's economic warfare threat
gist: This is a brief podcast-episode teaser rather than a full transcript; the visible text only previews two headlines covered in the episode -- Saudi pressure on Iraq over Iran-backed militias, and a rare Syrian foreign-minister visit to Pakistan -- while the title's claim about Iran rejecting Trump's economic-warfare threat is not elaborated in the available text.
